NVIDIA RTX Video SDK — Third-Party Notice
==========================================

Sonaflow includes runtime components from the NVIDIA RTX Video SDK for
real-time RTX Video Super Resolution (VSR) upscaling.

The following file is proprietary software owned by NVIDIA Corporation:
  - nvngx_vsr.dll

These components are subject to the NVIDIA RTX SDK / NGX End User License
Agreement. By using Sonaflow's upscaling feature you agree to those terms.

  RTX Video SDK: https://developer.nvidia.com/rtx-video-sdk
  NGX EULA:      https://docs.nvidia.com/ngx/latest/ngx-eula/index.html

This software contains components provided by NVIDIA Corporation.
